answer.answer: No figure for AAPL is in the CONFLICTING evidence state — the coverage report shows CONFLICTING: 0. The disagreement is recorded instead as an ambiguity block attached to the observations themselves, and in every such record the resolution is NO_WINNER_SELECTED: ST-EVA has deliberately not chosen between the values, so the evidence does not establish which is correct. A concrete case I retrieved: net_income for the fiscal year ended 2007-09-29. The same source concept (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss) is reported with two different values by two SEC filings — USD 3,496,000,000 in the 10-K (accession 0001193125-09-214859) and USD 3,495,000,000 in the 10-K/A (accession 0001193125-10-012091). Both observations are SOURCE_REPORTED with an EXACT mapping, both are UNVERIFIABLE, and a cross-check lookup on each returns an empty list, so no independent source has tested either figure. The record's own explanation is that the figures may be a restatement, a re-filing, or two different periods of coverage, and that the evidence does not establish which filing a question was about. The same pattern recurs elsewhere in the observations I retrieved, always with no winner selected: revenue for FY2007 (USD 24,006,000,000 vs USD 24,578,000,000; the revenue mapping here is PARTIAL, not EXACT), total assets at 2008-09-27 (USD 39,572,000,000 in three filings vs USD 36,171,000,000 in one), diluted EPS for FY2008 (5.36 vs 6.78), net income for FY2008 (USD 4,834,000,000 vs USD 6,119,000,000), net income for the nine months to 2009-06-27 (USD 4,039,000,000 vs USD 5,703,000,000), diluted EPS for FY2009 (6.29 vs 9.08), net income for FY2009 (USD 5,704,000,000 vs USD 8,235,000,000), and total assets at 2009-09-26 (USD 53,851,000,000 vs USD 47,501,000,000 across seven filings). In each case the disagreement is between filings of the same issuer, not between independent providers, and no determination is recorded. So the competing values are the pairs above, and the answer to which is correct is that the evidence held does not settle it: the disagreeing figures remain unresolved, and the metric series for FY2007 net income carries two points at that single period rather than one.
uncertainties: The evidence does not establish which filing is authoritative for any of the disputed figures; each ambiguity record carries resolution NO_WINNER_SELECTED.

No cross-check is recorded for either competing value in the FY2007 net income case: a validation lookup on both observations returned an empty list, so agreement has not been tested even between the filings themselves.
The list of disagreements is not exhaustive. 1,925 observations are held for AAPL and the listing I retrieved was truncated, so further unresolved pairs may exist beyond the ones named.

The disagreement is recorded in an ambiguity field on the observations; the evidence state on those same observations remains SOURCE_REPORTED, and the coverage report counts zero CONFLICTING metrics, so the two signals describe the same records differently.
Whether the competing figures reflect a restatement, a re-filing, or differing period coverage is not stated by the evidence; the record only lists those possibilities.
